bagPolicy.summary: Bags, backpacks and suitcases larger than A4 are not allowed at Deutsche Bank Park.
allowed: Bags and backpacks no larger than A4
prohibited: Bags, backpacks and suitcases larger than A4
Bulky items such as cases, ladders and chairs
Weapons and knives of any kind
bagPolicy.note: The stadium has no bag drop at its entry gates. Concert promoters may set additional rules, so check the promoter's site.

parking.summary: Parking near the stadium is limited, so arrive early. The Parkhaus Sandhofstraße garage is nearby, and for selected events and match days parking can be booked in advance; some lots accept pre-booked tickets only. There are 34 spaces near the stadium for people with reduced mobility, and you must show your blue disabled parking permit.

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by Deutsche Bank Park. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: Food and drinks are sold at 22 permanent stadium kiosks according to the venue’s concert visitor guide.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: The official venue guidance does not specify a general concert accessibility arrangement for concerts; consult the event instructions.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: Re-entry is not possible. Under the stadium rules, once your ticket has been scanned, it becomes invalid when you leave the Deutsche Bank Park grounds.

ticketPickup.summary: The official venue guidance does not specify a general will-call pickup procedure for concerts; consult the event instructions.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Entry requires a valid event ticket and security screening under the stadium regulations; use the gate assigned for your concert.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
